scenarioMeta.title: Mount a full board
scenarioMeta.description: Measure construction plus first render of the standard start position.
scenarioMeta.parity: Both mounted with identical size, orientation, coordinates off, animation off, interactivity off, from the same FEN placement.
scenarioMeta.endCondition: The board element has been laid out and all 32 piece boxes have non-zero geometry.

scenarioMeta.title: 100 position updates, animation off
scenarioMeta.description: Replay a sequence of board positions with animation disabled.
scenarioMeta.parity: Animation disabled on both. Every update carries placement, lastMove and side-to-move, exactly as a real app does. Each update is flushed to the DOM inside the timed region, because chessground defers its render to a requestAnimationFrame while quadrum renders synchronously — without the flush chessground would be timed doing nothing and would collapse 100 updates into a single render.
scenarioMeta.endCondition: Every position has been applied AND rendered into the DOM, and the board has been laid out; piece count matches the final placement.

scenarioMeta.title: 100 position updates, animation on
scenarioMeta.description: Replay a sequence of board positions with animation enabled.
scenarioMeta.parity: Animation enabled on both at 200ms. Positions are applied one per animation frame, so both libraries face the same arrival rate.
scenarioMeta.endCondition: All updates dispatched and one further frame has been painted.

scenarioMeta.title: Engine arrow re-draw, per tick
scenarioMeta.description: Replace the engine arrow layer 100 times without changing the position.
scenarioMeta.parity: Both mounted with drawing enabled and a static position; only the auto/engine arrow layer is replaced per tick. Neither adapter re-applies the FEN — doing so would make this measure a full position diff.
scenarioMeta.endCondition: The new arrow layer is present in the DOM and laid out; the position is unchanged.

scenarioMeta.title: Drag latency, p95
scenarioMeta.description: Measure input handling cost across a press-drag-release gesture.
scenarioMeta.parity: Both mounted interactive with dragging enabled. The identical gesture — press on e2, drag to e4 with 12 waypoints paced at 8 ms each (125 Hz mouse rate), release — is driven by the runner as real browser input at the same viewport coordinates, so neither library is asked to respond to an event family it does not listen to. Timing covers the page-side handling of each input event only; the runner round-trip is excluded by starting the clock inside the page.
scenarioMeta.endCondition: The library has entered its drag state and written a transform on the dragged piece, and the gesture has been released.

scenarioMeta.title: Resize storm, 50 resizes
scenarioMeta.description: Resize the board box 50 times and verify clicks still resolve correctly.
scenarioMeta.parity: Both are resized through the same host-box style write. Each adapter then does whatever it needs to remain CORRECT — which for chessground means redrawAll(). The contract is a correct, clickable board afterwards, not an equal number of method calls.
scenarioMeta.endCondition: The board box has the new size AND a click at the centre of a known square still resolves to that square.

scenarioMeta.title: Retention after teardown
scenarioMeta.description: Measure retained nodes and memory after destroying boards.
scenarioMeta.parity: Identical mount/update/destroy cycles at two cycle counts. Every node and listener count — baseline and post-cycle, both arms — is read only after three forced GCs, so what is reported is what survived collection rather than what had not yet been swept.
scenarioMeta.endCondition: All boards destroyed, hosts detached, three forced GCs complete, and the node/listener counters read back at that settled point.

scenarioMeta.title: Bundle size, min+brotli
scenarioMeta.description: Measure library bundle sizes in lib-mode builds.
scenarioMeta.parity: Both measured from a realistic adapter-surface entry (mount, update, arrows, drag, destroy), not `export *`, which is meaningless against subpath exports and pessimistic against a single entry.
scenarioMeta.endCondition: Three lib-mode builds complete and their raw/gzip/brotli byte counts are recorded.
